title: My Cousin Stole My $98K Cheese Cave and Gave Me a $4,200 Rind Check. So I Voided the Sale
description: I cashed out my nursing pension to start a cheese aging cave with my cousin, only for her to forge a dissolution, sell my share, and hand me a $4,200 'rind' check. Discovering the original partnership contract hidden in a hollow cheese wheel by my late aunt, I voided the sale and now run 'Whey of Betrayal Creamery,' where she flips aging wheels wearing a hairnet that says 'Cultured Lies' and every label bears her perjury docket number. #FamilyBetrayal #CheeseCaveRevenge #TrueStory
thumb_text: SHE NOW FLIPS CHEESE IN A CULTURED LIES HAIRNET
pinned_comment: If your cousin had stolen your retirement-funded cheese cave and handed you a $4,200 'rind' check, would you have gone searching for the hidden contract, or would you have walked away? Share your story in the comments.
